summary: Accept unambiguous merge commit ticket suffixes

delivery.outcome: Resume an existing ticket through Goal when a genuine legacy synchronization merge has one exact trailing ticket binding.

architecture.decision: Read actual Git parent metadata and accept the closed legacy synchronization subject only for a merge commit. Retain ordinary commit binding, scope, authority and all required CI checks.
architecture.rollback: Revert the parser change through protected review; preserve original branch history.

nonGoals: Do not accept unbound ordinary commits or ambiguous ticket identities
Do not rewrite published history, waive CI or modify standard adoption and example versions

validation.evidence: Real Git histories exercise merge and non-merge ticket binding.
Negative ticket identity regressions and existing delivery contracts remain passing.
Managed governance, all required exact-head CI and independent protected publication.
